name: Runner Extras - AL Dictionary target cell
brief: Regression pin: AL Dictionary semantics in a first-party test app, as a method local and as a global.
description: NavObjectDictionary<TKey,TValue>.get_Target lazily builds its backing SharedNavObjectDictionary by chaining base.Tree.Session.Company.SharedObjects; when that chain yields null the real body throws ArgumentNullException (Parameter 'parent'). Pageworks hits exactly that in a 7-test cluster. These tests were written to reproduce it from a first-party test app and DO NOT — every case here passes against BC's own unpatched get_Target, which proves the session/company/SharedObjects chain IS correctly wired for codeunits in the app under test. That is a useful negative result, so the suite is kept as a regression pin: it locks in working Dictionary semantics (add, get, count, containskey, remove, key-not-found error, two different closed instantiations) for the path that works, and narrows the real gap to whatever differs in the failing path. Do not read a pass here as coverage of the Pageworks cluster.
